_about: Test states for the v1.6 final dev build: the new games (Kirby x2, F-Zero Climax) and the contextual toggle's states (issue #37; turn Settings > Second screen > Contextual toggle on first). Made by tools/make_device_states.py --manifest tools/device-states-v1.6.json. A toggle state keeps its slot unless the release already has a state there from v1.5.6 / v1.5.7 (tools/device-states.json); then it takes the highest free slot, and the highest slots again if none is free.
